scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@harness/agent && npm run build --workspace=@harness/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@harness/agent-service && npm run build --workspace=@harness/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@harness/agent && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run format:check
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=@harness/desktop
scripts.dev:service: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=@harness/agent-service
scripts.smoke:desktop: npm run build && npm run smoke --workspace=@harness/desktop
